name: Spirit Cocoa
source:
After the death of his twin brother, Jay finds the winter holidays to be more painful than comforting. On the way to visit his boyfriend, he encounters a strange child who seems to understand his pain...

[From [url=https://coco-adventurer.itch.io/spirit-cocoa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
双胞胎兄弟去世后，杰伊发现寒假更加痛苦而不是安慰。在探望男友的路上，他遇到了一个奇怪的孩子，这个孩子似乎能理解他的痛苦……

[来自[url=https://coco-adventurer.itch.io/spirit-cocoa]itch.io[/url]]
